hero.description1: Bringing digital skills to those who need them most,

about.cardText: We are a non-profit civil association committed to closing the digital divide in Mexico. We work so that every person, regardless of context, can access the technology tools they need to transform their reality.
about.cardAdditional: We don't just teach technology—we build learning communities where people discover their potential and shape their future.

allies.subtitle: We value each of our allies. Thank you for trusting and building with us.

items.title: Cybersecurity Training
items.description: Intensive workshop to strengthen safe digital skills in vulnerable sectors. Basic data protection practices and responsible browsing were covered.

items.title: Social Technology Fair
items.description: A day to share technology tools applied to community issues. Young people from rural areas participated with innovative projects in digital accessibility.

items.title: Digital Innovation Workshop
items.description: An initiative to boost technological skills, creativity and digital inclusion among youth and entrepreneurs. This workshop is part of the professionalization program for vulnerable communities.

hero.title: About us.
hero.teContamosAlt: Let us tell you more about us!

quienesSomos.title: Who we are?
quienesSomos.p1: Democratizamos la Innovación, A.C. is committed to challenging the status quo by providing disruptive opportunities for personal and community development through education, training, and support for the popular economy through entrepreneurship.
quienesSomos.p2: We focus especially on empowering vulnerable populations, strengthening their agency to drive positive change in their lives and in society as a whole.
quienesSomos.p3: Our goals are to create equal opportunities and inspire innovative solutions that challenge established norms and promote a fairer and more equitable society.

missionVision.missionFront: We empower people in vulnerable contexts with digital skills so they can access better opportunities and build a fairer society.
missionVision.missionBack: We empower people toward better economic opportunities by strengthening their autonomy through digital skills that enhance their personal, professional, and social development. We democratize innovation and technology as tools for inclusion, focusing on those facing the greatest barriers, to build a more equitable, creative, and resilient society.
missionVision.visionTitle: A world where innovation is a right.
missionVision.visionFront: We want to be a global force that inspires, transforms, and opens paths so that all people can build a sustainable and inclusive future.
missionVision.visionBack: Democratizamos la Innovación envisions itself as a transformative and revolutionary force, a leader in promoting human development and social innovation. We seek to transcend borders and barriers, being recognized for our radical and positive impact on the lives of people and communities globally. We aspire to be pioneers in creating a more sustainable, inclusive, and vibrant world, where every individual has the opportunity and power to turn their dreams into reality and actively contribute to building a better future for all.

values.title: Equity
values.description: The recognition that not all people start from the same conditions and the building of fair and accessible opportunities for all people.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: The ability to generate creative, efficient, and socially impactful solutions through critical thinking, continuous learning, and adaptability to change.

values.title: Collaboration
values.description: Bringing together talents, knowledge, resources, and efforts in a transparent and co-responsible way to achieve a common goal.

values.title: Commitment
values.description: Represents the firm and constant responsibility to work with integrity, transparency, and dedication.

items.title: Agility.
items.description: We avoid unnecessary bureaucracy. We act quickly, decisively, and focused on solutions that create social value.

items.title: Resilience.
items.description: In the face of challenges, we find creative alternatives. We adapt, learn, and move forward without losing our way.

items.title: Conviction.
items.description: Every action has purpose. We deeply believe in the impact that innovation can have on people's lives.

propuestaValor.intro: Our proposal is articulated in six components that strengthen people's capabilities to improve their economic autonomy, their participation in the digital economy, and their well-being, with a focus on social inclusion and local development.

cards.title: Professionalization
cards.description: We strengthen the capabilities of self-employed people, entrepreneurs, and local teams through training processes that allow them to improve the management of their economic activity, adapt to digital environments, and make better decisions for their livelihood and growth.

cards.title: Technological Skills
cards.description: We promote digital literacy and strengthen technological skills in people with different needs, providing practical knowledge to navigate digital environments with autonomy, improve their economic participation, and adapt to technological changes.

cards.title: Support
cards.description: We support people and productive projects in implementing technological solutions and innovation processes, providing guidance, mentoring, and follow-up to reduce barriers and facilitate the adoption of technology in an accessible and relevant way.

cards.title: Awareness
cards.description: We promote a culture of responsible and conscious use of technology, fostering understanding of its social, economic, and creative value, as well as basic knowledge about rights, innovation, and idea protection.

cards.title: Guidance
cards.description: We channel people toward support networks, complementary services, and technological resources that strengthen their development, facilitating access to tools, equipment, and opportunities that would otherwise be inaccessible.

cards.title: Protection
cards.description: We guide people and projects in understanding basic mechanisms for protecting their ideas and innovations, helping knowledge and creativity generate sustainable value and fair recognition.

modelo.p1: At Democratizamos la Innovación, A.C. we understand digital inclusion as an integral process that goes beyond access to technology: it involves
modelo.p1Bold: educating, connecting, supporting, and empowering people so they can use it with purpose.
modelo.p2: That is why our model focuses on five complementary axes that strengthen personal, economic, and social development.
modelo.p3: Each axis connects with the others, forming a network that drives social transformation through technology.
